entries.title: Read custom connections from a shared connection file
entries.body: Settings → Intelligence has a Connection file row: choose a models.json file and Infinitary lists each connection it defines. Each computer approves a connection with its own key, a new name or price applies at once, a changed limit checks the model again, and a new address or header pauses the connection until you approve it again. Infinitary only reads the file and never uses a key written in it.

picture.alt: Settings → Intelligence with a chosen connection file and a connection from it waiting for Approve
